lore.description: An acid slime organism protected by a thick rocky exoskeleton, Bioflim was bioengineered by Drainov's Xalian Generator to endure a world of bubbling acid swamps and steaming corrosive rain. Its slime continually regenerates the outer shell, so the casing that the swamps eat away is replaced as fast as it dissolves. Under the crime syndicates that took the planet after the Vallerii were driven off, Bioflim was set to work in the reopened factories and refineries, where a body that survives contact with what it handles is worth more than a body that moves quickly. It stands in the acid and does not wear through.
lore.biomeNiche: the acid swamps and reopened chemical plants of Drainov

signatureAbility.name: Everforming Carapace
signatureAbility.description: The slime beneath floods over the broken plates and hardens into new shell faster than the acid can take it away.
